name: Back Defense Protocol
description: Brian Glick's Only Way Out: Dynamic Back Escapes covers hand fighting, hooks, body triangles and strangle defense from rear control.
summary: Only Way Out: Dynamic Back Escapes by Brian Glick covers escaping rear control from either side, including body triangles, trapped arms and strangle attempts.
overview: Brian Glick devotes this seven-volume course to the problems that arise once an opponent controls your back. It combines defensive hand fighting with escapes from either side and from the body triangle, including routes to closed guard, half guard and ashi garami. Separate material addresses crucifix control, standing back control and strangle defenses at different stages.

products.title: Only Way Out: Dynamic Back Escapes
products.blurb: Rear-mount escapes, body-triangle solutions and strangle defenses across seven volumes.
products.best_for: Grapplers whose recurring defensive problem is established back control.

fits: You repeatedly get stuck in rear mount, especially when hooks, a body triangle or a trapped arm complicate the escape.
You want back escapes and strangle defenses in the same course.

includes: Defensive hand fighting, trapped-arm problems, elbow cuts, barrel rolls and folding or bridging.
Overhook-side and underhook-side escapes, hook troubleshooting, body-triangle escapes and guard recovery.
Special rear controls, including the crucifix and standing back control; early-, middle- and late-stage strangle defense.
limits: The course concentrates on rear control. Mount and side-pin escapes are outside its main curriculum.
